cases.finding: The retrieved company-tax text assigns carry-forward/offset to a tax loss. The answer assigns it to pension contribution limits. This directly supports a scope/subject substitution observation without needing to adjudicate Irish tax law. It does not prove removing that document would correct the answer.

quotes.quote: there will be a tax loss that can be carried forward and offset against future profits
There are maximum contribution limits, but these can be carried forward and offset against future profits
